card.name: Words right before "concentration(s)"
card.fires_on: The word just before "concentration" or "concentrations", when the next word is predicted to be that term. Seen in dilution and storage instructions and in drug-interaction text, e.g. "plasma", "peak", "final volume", "for", "to".
